basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant (Admn.) post on a project-based tenure up to the project duration with posting in Bhubaneshwar. The required qualification for the post is Graduation plus 15 years working experience as per job description. The notified pay is Rs. 26,000 to 57,000/- plus HRA. Candidates can apply by email, by post, or produce the application at the time of interview, submitting it with a detailed CV, attested copies of degree or certificate and experience certificate on or before 25 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply

rows.essential_qualification_required: Graduation + 15 years working experience as per job description

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The approved emoluments range from Rs. 26,000/- to 57,000/- plus HRA per month. The engagement duration is up to the project duration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Admn.)
content_sections.text: Ensure eligibility for the position before applying. Prepare an application on a plain paper. Compile a detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree and certificates obtained. Attach experience certificates including research, industrial field and others. Attach attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Submit the application by email to [email protected] or send it by post to the office of Principal Investigator, or produce the application at the time of interview on or before October 25, 2026 by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates desiring to appear for the interview should submit their applications with the required documents through email, by post or produce at the time of interview. Candidates must bring along with them the original degree/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview, and preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the tenure of the Project Assistant (Admn.) position?
faq.answer: The tenure is up to the project duration.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances provided in addition to the monthly pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the position offers emoluments ranging from Rs. 26,000/- to 57,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit an application on a plain paper with a detailed CV showing chronological discipline of degrees/certificates obtained, along with attested copies of degrees, certificates, and experience certificates in research, industrial field, and others.

faq.question: Q4. Where should candidates send their applications?
faq.answer: Applications can be emailed to the Principal Investigator at [email protected], sent by post to the office of the Principal Investigator, or produced at the time of interview.
